strings: As r_c0 listens to m_c's breathing, {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/confirm/confirms} m_c's fear: this isn't the normal sound of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} raspy lungs. m_c has developed longcough.
m_c's raspy lungs have left {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with longcough.
m_c's raspy lungs have caused {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to develop longcough.
